summaries.product: Software engineer who takes web and mobile products from idea to launch: founding engineer and product lead at a real estate startup, and solo builder of an app live on the App Store and Google Play. PhD researcher in Materials Chemistry with a machine learning background.
summaries.research: Software engineer and PhD researcher in Materials Chemistry who builds tools for scientists. Machine learning thesis on adsorption energy calculations, an open-source research workspace used in my own lab work, and 3+ years shipping web and mobile products with React, Next.js, React Native and Node.js.
